findings.title: The threshold converts motion into speech
findings.claim: The ayah moves from directed motion to a material mark, from the mark to a threshold encounter, and from that encounter into contested speech.
findings.mechanism: The race supplies the first direction, the door supplies the common threshold, the cut supplies a retained physical trace, and the direct-speech form attaches an alleged harm and penalty to what has just become visible; later inquiry connections show why this sequence can remain consequential.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse's actions become newly perceptible as one chain in which movement generates evidence and evidence becomes the object of competing language.
findings.containment: This is a bounded integration of the supplied sequence, not a ranking of the separate forensic, household, penalty, prison, or garment readings that remain independently accounted for.

epistemic.reason: The synthesis comes from an unbound HFT summary, but every stage is returned through supplied focus occurrences and the later inquiry connections are explicit.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: harekette ya da işte öne geçme ve yarışarak ön alma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, hareket, koşu ya da bir işte başkasından önce gelme ve önde bulunma ilişkisidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The racing form carries the initiating directed movement.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The named door and subsequent tear give the movement a concrete trajectory.
branch_activations.activation: The race contacts the door and the material consequence, beginning the sequence that later becomes speech.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Motion is the first stage in a chain that produces evidence.
branch_activations.boundary: The sequence does not make motion itself a moral verdict.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin içine geçilen açıklık veya giriş noktasıdır ve somut kapıyı da kapsar.
branch_activations.carrier: The door carries the shared spatial threshold of the sequence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The race approaches it and the encounter is found beside it.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated door carrier joins the beginning and middle of the chain, changing goal-space into encounter-space.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threshold is where movement becomes exposed relation.
branch_activations.boundary: No universal threshold symbolism is asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kesme veya yarma, nesnenin uzunluğu boyunca yapılır; enine kesme bu sınırın dışındadır.
branch_activations.carrier: The cut carries the physical trace between movement and speech.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The shirt and rear-side direction give the cut a located affected surface.
branch_activations.activation: The cut contacts the garment and direction, making the middle stage of the sequence a retained mark.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The encounter does not begin with words; it inherits a material trace from the chase.
branch_activations.boundary: The cut remains an ordinary completed tearing event as well as this integrated secondary relation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: The direct-speech form carries the outward verbalization of the claim.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The recompense, alleged-intention, and later inquiry refs give the speech a contested object and continuing consequence.
branch_activations.activation: The speech contacts the already visible mark and turns the material sequence into an asserted account of harm and penalty.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Evidence becomes contested speech at the threshold rather than remaining silent description.
branch_activations.boundary: The integrated sequence does not decide which spoken account is true.
